[P1] Do not infer read-only execution from table privileges alone

A PostgreSQL user can have no writable tables and still execute a mutating `SECURITY DEFINER` function, which writes using its owner's permissions. These queries return false/empty for that user, so the gate silently allows `SELECT app.mutate()` and caches that permission for the process. A permitted Redshift Lambda UDF can similarly write using the Lambda function's execution role, independently of database table grants. Account for callable write-capable functions before returning `read-only`, or return `unknown` so the existing consent path handles capabilities this check cannot establish.
